boost_quality_opportunities.recommendation: Replace the clickbait title with one that says what the article argues, and drop the ' | Pushka. Brain' suffix; shorten the subtitle to under 140 characters.
Remove or replace the YouTube frames with original, licensed or properly credited images, and add credits and alt text.
State the source episode and the author's relationship to it near the top, and delete the meta-description blockquote.
Add the author's own perspective, such as why they care about this topic, what they checked beyond the video, or where they disagree with the episode, only if that is genuinely theirs to give.
Make the synthesis the center of the piece: pick two or three studies and examine them in depth against the primary papers rather than touring eight topics in order.
Cut the repeated aphoristic one-line paragraphs and stacked metaphors, and keep the cross-link only if it is directly relevant.
